method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie在将近午夜时把4Runner开进院子，差点忘了为防人跟踪而绕路回家的惯例（她脑子里防的是Tommy）。
facts.anchor: It was almost midnight by the time she pulled the 4Runner into the yard.

facts.fact: Hattie认定Leah、Dustin、Colm三个人全都撒了谎。
私家侦探Eeling曾秘密调查这三个孩子，但每个孩子在Cheryl被杀时都有不在场证明。
facts.anchor: but each of the kids had alibis for the time of Cheryl’s murder.

facts.fact: Hattie又想起Eeling档案里Ramsby提供的照片，觉得那正是切开这个死结的工具。
facts.anchor: the mention of photos from Ramsby in Eeling’s files resurfaces again.

facts.fact: Hattie正要进门时电话响了，来电号码是陌生的。
facts.anchor: her phone rings. The number is foreign

facts.fact: 来电者是Adam（她一时没认出声音），他称她为Mary，并为这么晚打电话道歉。
facts.anchor: “Mary? Sorry to call you so late—I was just going to leave a message.”

facts.fact: Adam叹气说情况不好，出事的是父亲Sloan。
Adam告诉Hattie父亲Sloan心脏病发作了。
facts.anchor: “He had a heart attack.” Adam pauses

facts.fact: Adam说医生们还不确定Sloan能否挺过来。
facts.anchor: “They’re not sure he’s going to make it.”
